verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
verses.en: [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.

verses.he: אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.en: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.he: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
verses.en: My soul shall glory in the LORD; The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.he: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.en: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.

verses.he: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל־מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃
verses.en: I sought the LORD, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

verses.he: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃
verses.en: They looked unto Him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be abashed.

verses.he: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, And saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.he: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃
verses.en: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear Him, And delivereth them.

verses.he: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O consider and see that the LORD is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him.

verses.he: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃
verses.en: O fear the LORD, ye His holy ones;  For there is no want to them that fear Him.

verses.he: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא־יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek the LORD want not any good thing.

verses.he: לְֽכוּ־בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.he: מִֽי־הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Who is the man that desireth life, and loveth days, That he may see good therein?

verses.he: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.he: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃
verses.en: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, And His ears are open unto their cry.

verses.he: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.en: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.he: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃
verses.en: They cried, and the LORD heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

verses.he: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.en: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

verses.he: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Many are the ills of the righteous, But the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃
verses.en: He keepeth all his bones; Not one of them is broken.

verses.he: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.en: Evil shall kill the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be held guilty.

verses.he: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל־הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The LORD redeemeth the soul of His servants; And none of them that take refuge in Him shall be desolate.
